acceptance_scope: Nationwide weather, official warnings, agriculture, aviation, marine, hydrology and climate

capabilities.name: Point forecast
capabilities.limitation: Six locations only; forecast skill/run revisions unvalidated.

capabilities.name: Official observation and nowcast
capabilities.limitation: Canonical API samples returned 401; supported access/contract required.

capabilities.name: District warnings and CAP
capabilities.limitation: WFS day validity, 22 quarantined features, national completeness, CAP lifecycle and location matching unresolved.

capabilities.name: Farmer bulletins
capabilities.limitation: 698 source-listed district entries; four PDFs sampled, crop/stage and validity extraction incomplete.

capabilities.name: Aviation
capabilities.limitation: Six airports sampled; METAR/TAF is not a complete operational briefing.

capabilities.name: Marine
capabilities.limitation: Wave models plus official PDFs; operational region/time interpretation and other warning products incomplete.

capabilities.name: Hydrology
capabilities.limitation: River identity, gauge comparison, official flood warnings and exposure missing.

capabilities.name: National climate
capabilities.limitation: National geography only; preserve known aggregate discrepancies.

capabilities.name: District climate
capabilities.limitation: 640 historical series; only Ahmedabad source-reconciled; source reuse restrictions and modern boundaries unresolved.

capabilities.name: Geography
capabilities.limitation: 1516 versioned source records; no authoritative LGD export or reviewed crosswalks. 1496 reference-only assessments; no operational coverage promotion.

capabilities.name: Language and voice
capabilities.limitation: Gujarati source PDF available; multilingual extraction, translation and speech evaluation incomplete.

remaining_gates.title: Supported official API access
remaining_gates.evidence: Recorded 401 responses for canonical IMD routes
remaining_gates.closure_requirement: Obtain supported access and validate authenticated payloads; retain public routes as separately identified products.

remaining_gates.title: Alert applicability
remaining_gates.evidence: WFS validity unresolved, 22 quarantines; all nine CAP samples expired
remaining_gates.closure_requirement: Document day/time mapping, repair/replace source geometry through a reviewed version, reconcile CAP update/cancel chains and measure coverage.

remaining_gates.title: Nationwide and specialist acceptance
remaining_gates.closure_requirement: Resolve administrative/station/river/sea-region mapping; validate relevant operational aviation, marine and hydrology inputs.

remaining_gates.title: Historical data reuse and reconciliation
remaining_gates.evidence: Original publication page 3 restrictions; 639 other historical series not reconciled
remaining_gates.closure_requirement: Confirm intended-use permission or replace with a suitably licensed source; reconcile remaining series before claims.

remaining_gates.title: Advisory language and field relevance
remaining_gates.evidence: Document extraction only; no field feedback
remaining_gates.closure_requirement: Validate issue/expiry, crop/stage context and local-language/voice behavior with representative cases.

remaining_gates.title: Accuracy and reliability
remaining_gates.evidence: Single-session access, schema and representative sample checks
remaining_gates.closure_requirement: Benchmark forecast skill against observations, update cadence, outage behavior, latency and capacity with approved acceptance thresholds.

candidate_assessments.reason: Station search sampled; weather payload requests returned 403 and portal HTML contains unexplained Android external-window code. Official observation access gate remains open.

resolved_reproduced_gaps: schema-invalid response cannot replace active validated forecast cache
missing or invalid returned grid coordinates rejected
obsolete or incomplete river forecast rejected
remaining_constraints: Administrative/geographic mapping and spatial applicability unvalidated
Source issue-time freshness remains unknown where not supplied
Warning validity, lifecycle and feed completeness unresolved
